prepareInstallation.description: Deploy the budget, then each node's own action and splitter. Every declaration is a fresh clone. Setup supplies the flow budget to action initializers. Permission recipients are actual addresses; each component adds the permissions it requires. When the budget is a StreamBudget, the install proposal must also call writeCheckpoint() on it (the first helper) after applyInstallation: the stream accrues nothing until then.
